mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces present value of future cash flows, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5) despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5% signals aggressive tightening amid accelerating inflation, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL monthly change are negatively correlated, or 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, UNRATE < 4.0% signals labor market tightness that triggers inflationary pressures and forced monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.0) despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing starts above 1000 (HOUST > 1000) indicates robust consumer demand and construction activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1000 (HOUST < 1000) signals weak consumer demand and economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1000).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105 (INDPRO > 105) indicates strong manufacturing output and economic expansion, supporting corporate profitability and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous INDPRO > 105 and PAYEMS > 140000 signals strong economic expansion with robust production and labor markets, reducing recession risk and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when INDPRO and PAYEMS move in opposite directions, or 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances.
